title: OfacMatch: explainable OFAC sanctions name screening
description:
OfacMatch screens person, company, vessel and aircraft names against the U.S. Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and explains every potential match, combining whole-name and name-part comparison (Jaro-Winkler similarity and Soundex) on OFAC's 0-100 scale. It flags date-of-birth and country conflicts, runs locally, and is evaluated on the real SDN list with a held-out test on names not used during development: at a threshold of 85 it finds all 4,235 realistic variations of listed names and 99.6% of 2,160 harder ones, and it is compared with eight standard name-matching methods.

Available as a .NET library (NuGet: OfacMatch), an MCP server for AI assistants (NuGet: OfacMatch.Mcp) and a browser-based demonstration at https://krunalsolanki.github.io/ofac-match/.
